name: Nerola (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Nerola (a crowned head on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Nerola, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Nerola arms — crowned head on white, crowned, within branches
